description: The standard edition adds visual style customization for charts on top of the basic edition. IIChartStandard is the standard edition of the native MFC/Win32 chart control that ports Apache ECharts through WebView2, supporting both x86 and x64 platforms. Official website: https://www.xw-industrial.com/ ; Github: https://github.com/XuweiIntelligentTechnology/IIChart
summary: WebView2 + ECharts chart control for MFC/Win32 native C++ projects (Standard edition, x86/x64).
title: IIChartStandard (Intelligent Industrial Chart Control - Standard Edition)
